name: How long does a typical shower replacement project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical shower replacement project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a shower replacement project varies depending on its complexity. A basic replacement of a pre-fabricated shower unit might take 1-3 days. A more involved project, such as a custom tiled shower or a tub-to-shower conversion that requires significant demolition and plumbing adjustments, could take 3-7 days. These timelines generally account for demolition, new plumbing installation, waterproofing, wall surfacing, and fixture installation. We can provide a more accurate estimate during an on-site consultation in areas like Surprise or Waddell.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical shower replacement takes 1-7 days, depending on complexity. Basic replacements are quicker, while custom or conversion projects take longer.
